title: Androidaps does not display latest value as read by xdrip
body:
On AndroidAPS Overview Tab the reading time of blood sugar value is behind xdrip+ latest reading. I have recorded this for 14.05.2023 11:06

Log files and screen recording in attached files:
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1684055313489.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/11489655/AndroidAPS_LOG_1684055313489.log.zip)
